trial_title: Trial Comparing Haloperidol, Quetiapine and Placebo in the Pharmacological Treatment of Delirium
brief_summary:
Background:

Delirium is an important problem in critical care. Its prevalence often reaches 75% in intensive care patients. Its occurrence is associated with numerous complications and deleterious consequences such as death, longer stay, higher cost, and long-term cognitive impairment. Delirium treatment entails correcting its underlying causes and usually initiating a pharmacological intervention with an antipsychotic.
